reason: I signed a 3-year processing deal with a free terminal and there is an exit fee, so I am not switching in the middle of it. A new app from people I do not know yet is a lot of trouble for a salon that is running fine.
objection: Card fees are where the real money is. Is yours really cheaper than what I pay now, and what do I pay to get out of my contract?
would_change_my_mind: A salon owner I know in the Facebook group tells me they switched and saved real money, and someone shows me my own statement against your 2.7% + 5 cents, including the exit fee, so I can see I come out ahead.
